crossRefs.note: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

parallels.note: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

translations.web: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”
translations.bsb: and some who were standing there asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
translations.kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
translations.asv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
